description.en: The village project with Old Wilf: a flat place in the shade of the oak, the ground levelled bump by bump, the ditch and the boards at its four corners, the grass sown and rolled smooth, and the first game and its winner.
description.sl: Vaški projekt s starim Wilfom: raven prostor v senci hrasta, tla poravnana grbina za grbino, jarek in deske na štirih kotih, posejana in gladko povaljana trava ter prva igra in njen zmagovalec.
description.it: Il progetto del paese con il vecchio Wilf: un posto piatto all'ombra della quercia, il terreno spianato gobba dopo gobba, il fossato e le sponde ai quattro angoli, l'erba seminata e rullata liscia, e la prima partita col suo vincitore.
description.de: Das Dorfprojekt mit dem alten Wilf: ein flacher Platz im Schatten der Eiche, der Boden Buckel für Buckel eingeebnet, der Graben und die Bretter an den vier Ecken, das Gras gesät und glatt gewalzt, und das erste Spiel mit seinem Sieger.

review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: A bowling green must be flat.
words.example_it: Un prato da bocce dev'essere piatto.
words.note: Flat as a table, flat as a pancake: very flat.
words.note_sl: Flat as a table, flat as a pancake: čisto ravno.
words.note_it: Flat as a table, flat as a pancake: piattissimo.
words.note_de: Flat as a table, flat as a pancake: ganz flach.

words.example_en: Wilf likes to sit in the shade of the oak.
words.example_sl: Wilf rad sedi v senci hrasta.
words.example_it: A Wilf piace sedersi all'ombra della quercia.
words.example_de: Wilf sitzt gern im Schatten der Eiche.
words.note: In the shade: out of the sun. A shadow is the dark shape the sun makes of you.
words.note_sl: In the shade: v senci, stran od sonca. Shadow je senca, ki jo mečeš ti.
words.note_it: In the shade: all'ombra. Shadow è l'ombra che fai tu.
words.note_de: In the shade: im Schatten. Shadow ist dein eigener Schatten.

words.example_en: The stones come out of the ground.
words.example_de: Die Steine kommen aus dem Boden.
words.note: On the ground: down where you stand.
words.note_de: On the ground: auf dem Boden.

words.example_en: There's a bump in the grass by the bench.
words.example_sl: V travi ob klopi je grbina.
words.example_it: Nell'erba vicino alla panchina c'è una gobba.
words.example_de: Im Gras bei der Bank ist ein Buckel.

words.example_en: A bowl in the ditch is out of the game.
words.example_sl: Krogla v jarku je izven igre.
words.example_it: Una boccia nel fossato è fuori gioco.
words.example_de: Eine Kugel im Graben ist aus dem Spiel.
words.note: Ditch and dish sound nearly the same: a ditch is in the ground, a dish is on the table.
words.note_sl: Ditch in dish zvenita skoraj enako: ditch je jarek, dish je krožnik.
words.note_it: Ditch e dish suonano quasi uguali: ditch è il fossato, dish è il piatto.
words.note_de: Ditch und dish klingen fast gleich: ditch ist der Graben, dish die Schüssel.

words.note: In the corner of a room, on the corner of a street.
words.note_sl: In the corner: v kotu sobe; on the corner: na vogalu ulice.
words.note_it: In the corner: nell'angolo della stanza; on the corner: all'angolo della strada.
words.note_de: In the corner: in der Zimmerecke; on the corner: an der Straßenecke.

words.example_en: We sow the grass seed in April.
words.example_de: Im April säen wir den Grassamen.
words.note: Sow and sew sound the same: you sow seeds and sew with a needle.
words.note_sl: Sow in sew zvenita enako: seme sow (seješ), z iglo sew (šivaš).
words.note_it: Sow e sew suonano uguali: i semi si sow (seminano), con l'ago si sew (cuce).
words.note_de: Sow und sew klingen gleich: Samen sow (sät) man, mit der Nadel sew (näht) man.

words.example_en: After the roller the grass is smooth.
words.example_it: Dopo il rullo l'erba è liscia.
words.example_de: Nach der Walze ist das Gras glatt.

words.example_en: Wilf is the winner of the first game.
words.example_it: Wilf è il vincitore della prima partita.
words.example_de: Wilf ist der Sieger des ersten Spiels.
words.note: Win, won, the winner. The one who loses: the loser.
words.note_sl: Win, won, the winner. Kdor izgubi: the loser.
words.note_it: Win, won, the winner. Chi perde: the loser.
words.note_de: Win, won, the winner. Wer verliert: the loser.

words.note_sl: First, second, third … last: prvi, drugi, tretji … zadnji.
words.note_it: First, second, third … last: primo, secondo, terzo … ultimo.
words.note_de: First, second, third … last: erster, zweiter, dritter … letzter.
